name: e1_add_zero
stmt: theorem e1_add_zero (n : Nat) : n + 0 = n := by

name: e2_two_two
stmt: theorem e2_two_two : 2 + 2 = 4 := by

name: e3_cong
stmt: theorem e3_cong (a b : Nat) (h : a = b) : a + 1 = b + 1 := by

name: e4_zero_add
stmt: theorem e4_zero_add (n : Nat) : 0 + n = n := by

name: e5_le_refl
stmt: theorem e5_le_refl (n : Nat) : n ≤ n := by

name: e6_sub_zero
stmt: theorem e6_sub_zero (n : Nat) : n - 0 = n := by

name: m1_double
stmt: theorem m1_double (n : Nat) : 2 * n = n + n := by

name: m2_add_assoc
stmt: theorem m2_add_assoc (a b c : Nat) : a + b + c = a + (b + c) := by

name: m3_succ_le
stmt: theorem m3_succ_le (n : Nat) : n ≤ n + 1 := by

name: m4_mul_one
stmt: theorem m4_mul_one (n : Nat) : n * 1 = n := by

name: m5_append_nil
stmt: theorem m5_append_nil (l : List Nat) : l ++ [] = l := by

name: m6_len_append_nil
stmt: theorem m6_len_append_nil (l : List Nat) : (l ++ []).length = l.length := by

name: m7_sub_self
stmt: theorem m7_sub_self (n : Nat) : n - n = 0 := by

name: m8_zero_sub
stmt: theorem m8_zero_sub (n : Nat) : 0 - n = 0 := by

name: h1_sq_succ
stmt: theorem h1_sq_succ (n : Nat) : (n + 1) * (n + 1) = n * n + 2 * n + 1 := by

name: h2_mul_comm
stmt: theorem h2_mul_comm (n m : Nat) : n * m = m * n := by

name: h3_pos_mul
stmt: theorem h3_pos_mul (n m : Nat) (h1 : 0 < n) (h2 : 0 < m) : 0 < n * m := by

name: h4_exists_succ
stmt: theorem h4_exists_succ (n : Nat) (h : n ≠ 0) : ∃ m, n = m + 1 := by

name: h5_swap
stmt: theorem h5_swap (a b : Nat) : 1 + a + b = a + b + 1 := by

name: h6_map_len
stmt: theorem h6_map_len (l : List Nat) : (l.map (fun x => x + 0)).length = l.length := by

name: h7_add_cancel
stmt: theorem h7_add_cancel (a b c : Nat) (h : a + b = a + c) : b = c := by

name: h8_distrib
stmt: theorem h8_distrib (a b : Nat) : 2 * (a + b) = 2 * a + 2 * b := by

name: h9_le_trans
stmt: theorem h9_le_trans (a b c : Nat) (h1 : a ≤ b) (h2 : b ≤ c) : a ≤ c := by

name: h10_succ_mul
stmt: theorem h10_succ_mul (n m : Nat) : (n + 1) * m = n * m + m := by
